title: Abbott i-STAT G Cartridge
usage: Hospitals Clinical Laboratories Emergency Departments (ER) Intensive Care Units (ICU) Critical Care Units (CCU)
desc: The Abbott i-STAT G Cartridge is a single-use, point-of-care test cartridge designed to quantitatively measure blood glucose levels from a small 65 µL whole blood sample in approximately two minutes. It works alongside handheld analyzers like the i-STAT 1 System to manage critical care and metabolic assessments
